history.event: Independent full-section and exact-draft review retained the lead as unresolved and set direction to null; conditional possible request-favouring effect remains in explanation. Original first-recorded metadata preserved.

card.law_is_about: Annual tax changes allowing necessary personal data for tax-authority AI.
card.they_want: Longer retention of training and validation data.
card.they_claim: The draft entails forced annual data destruction.
card.the_problem: The clock starts after measures end or continued-operation need ceases; the intended criticism needs clarification.

counter_quote.original: in dem Zeitpunkt, in dem die Daten für die Fortsetzung eines ordnungsgemäßen Betriebs des automatisierten Systems nicht länger erforderlich sind.
counter_quote.translation_en: Translation of fragment: at the time when the data are no longer required to continue proper operation of the automated system.

correction: The operative rule on p 28 starts the one-year period after the measures end; its continued-operation clause and explanation p 130 preserve necessary data until they are no longer needed for proper ongoing operation.
effect: If annual meant deletion during necessary ongoing use, the stated threat to continuing model validity is overstated.
limits: Not established as an error: p 4 accurately describes deletion within one year after the development or review measure ends. Annual may be shorthand for deletion following each completed measure; original-data audit concerns can extend beyond that point. No adjudication of model science, retention necessity or legal compatibility.
materiality_explanation: Potentially major because it would support changing retention law, but scope and intended reading remain unresolved. The asserted risk favours longer retention; severity is provisional pending clarification.
context_checked: Full p 4–5 retained: correct end-of-measure trigger appears before broader annual-destruction wording. Treating the latter as an unqualified annual purge could unfairly ignore that accurate qualification.
